articles.title: Hamas Security Chief Naim Abu Nahal Killed In Israeli Airstrike, Says IDF
articles.description: Israel said Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal was killed in an aerial strike in Gaza on Tuesday. The IDF and ISA alleged that he had facilitated attacks against Israeli troops and civilians and violated the ceasefire. Benjamin Netanyahu praised the operation, while Israeli authorities claimed precautionary measures were taken to minimise civilian harm.

articles.title: Israeli strikes kill Hamas security chief and six others in Gaza
articles.description: Two policemen died when a police station in southern Gaza was hit, while coalition talks in Israel leave caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu in charge of military operations.

articles.title: Israel kills senior Hamas security official in Gaza despite ceasefire
articles.description: An Israeli airstrike killed Naeem Abu Nahel, the head of Hamas' internal security apparatus in Gaza, in western Gaza City on Tuesday, Hamas sources said.
